parts: Big-Foot de Thalek Keep My Dream
Male, white and red, born on November 15, 2012.
Parents DNA-identified at the Royal Canine Society of Spain.
From the cross of our Portuguese, Spanish and International Champion Happily Ever After (Guizmo) with our lovely Spanish and International Champion Forget Me Nots (Engye).

Dreamy is now living with our friend Tove Aasheim Olsen (Twinkle Stars) and her Bobtails in Norway. We are grateful for the trust she has placed in us, our dogs and our breeding, and for acquiring Dreamy to show him in Europe.
We hope and wish him a successful show career, and hope Tove and her family enjoy this little sweetheart.
